title: Research CatalystX9 LabNotebookSOP

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the research task to transform the raw Catalyst-X9 lab notebook into an executable SOP for night-shift bench use. Generated: 1) Comprehensive analysis scripts extracting synthesis parameters; 2) Version-controlled SOP with safety checklists and troubleshooting; 3) Four visualizations (timeline, flowchart, summary stats, transformation diagram); 4) Complete research report documenting methodology and results. All deliverables are in the report/ directory including synthesis_sop.md and report.md with embedded figures.
